decision: Should Meridian Analytics (fictional B2B analytics company) enter the mid-market healthcare segment in the next 12 months, or stay focused on retail operations?

hypotheses.statement: The reachable mid-market healthcare segment is large enough to justify a 12-month entry.
Meridian can reach healthcare buyers through its existing motion without a new sales org.
Meridian's product can meet healthcare compliance (HIPAA) needs within 12 months.
Healthcare unit economics beat continued retail focus.
Brand perception transfers from retail to healthcare.

claims.statement: Reachable mid-market healthcare TAM is ~$420M, derived from segment count x average contract value.
Mid-market healthcare IT spend grew 11% YoY, faster than retail's 4%.
14% of Meridian's inbound demo requests in the last 2 quarters came from healthcare orgs unprompted.
A HIPAA-compliant deployment tier can be built on the current architecture in two quarters.
Healthcare CAC payback is ~14 months vs. ~11 months for retail, but ACV is 1.8x higher.
